summary: This note is a short biography of Jason Keng-Kwin Chan, born in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, who moved to Perth, Australia as a child. He studied medicine at the University of Western Australia while pursuing dance, later became a General Practitioner, and then trained in acting at the National Institute of Dramatic Art in Sydney. He co-founded the production company BananaMana Films with Christian Lee and currently lives in Singapore.
one_line: Biography of Jason Keng-Kwin Chan, a Malaysian-born Australian-trained doctor turned actor and co-founder of BananaMana Films.
key_facts: Jason Keng-Kwin Chan was born in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Chan moved to Perth, Australia with his family when he was 5 years old.
Chan entered medical school at the University of Western Australia.
Chan studied ballet, contemporary dance, and jazz dance at the Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts.
After graduating, Chan obtained his Fellowship in General Practice.
Chan worked as a General Practitioner for a few years before entering the National Institute of Dramatic Art (NIDA) in Sydney.
Chan obtained a Bachelor of Dramatic Arts in Acting at NIDA.
The note lists Mel Gibson, Cate Blanchett, Judy Davis, Baz Luhrmann and Hugo Weaving as other NIDA graduates.
Chan is the co-founder of the production company BananaMana Films.
Christian Lee is named as Chan's co-founder of BananaMana Films.
